confidence: These items are compiled from the official Roblox experience page, community data shared in established Dig & Clean guides (e.g., YouTube, Sportskeeda, All Things How), and the Squeaky Clean! group. Values and keep recommendations are community estimates unless the official game shop or catalog confirms them. Items labeled 'Community estimate' may not match live prices.

items.name: Plastic Bottle
items.description: A common piece of washed-up trash. Easy to find and easy to clean.
items.keepReason: Sell every copy. Junk items have no meaningful museum value and slow down your bag.

items.name: Old Can
items.description: Rusted aluminum can. The beach spawns many of these.
items.keepReason: Sell for quick starter coins. Do not waste museum slots on junk.

items.name: Broken Flip-Flop
items.description: Half of a sandal. Lightweight but low value.
items.keepReason: Only worth pocket change. Sell every time.

items.name: Seashell
items.description: A small spiral shell. Common beach find used for early museum fillers.
items.keepReason: Keep one only if you have an empty early museum slot. Otherwise sell for coins.

items.name: Sand Dollar
items.description: Flat, round shell often used for decoration.
items.keepReason: Best early museum value among common beach items. Keep one, sell duplicates.

items.name: Starfish
items.description: A five-armed sea star. Cute display item for beginners.
items.keepReason: Low but useful early museum value. Keep one if you need to fill slots, sell duplicates.

items.name: Message in a Bottle
items.description: A bottle with a mysterious note inside. Mid-tier value item.
items.keepReason: Decent museum value for an uncommon starter-island item. Keep one.

items.name: Rusty Anchor
items.description: A small iron anchor covered in barnacles. Can be found on beaches and near wrecks.
items.keepReason: Strong uncommon display. Keep first copy, sell duplicates after you have a clean one.

items.name: Gold Coin
items.description: A weathered gold coin from an old shipwreck. Rare and valuable.
items.keepReason: High museum value and good sell price. Keep one for the museum; duplicates sell well.

items.name: Silver Goblet
items.description: Ornate silver cup from a sunken banquet.
items.keepReason: Strong museum value. Keep first copy unless you need the coins for a major upgrade.

items.name: Ancient Vase
items.description: A cracked but beautiful ceramic vase. Epic-tier Shipwreck Cove treasure.
items.keepReason: Very high museum value. Always donate the first copy. Sell duplicates only if you have an even better replacement.

items.name: Pirate Cutlass
items.description: A curved pirate sword encrusted with barnacles.
items.keepReason: Top-tier museum display. Donate the first copy. Sell duplicates after you have a clean one.

items.name: Golden Chalice
items.description: A legendary golden cup fit for a king of the seas. One of the most valuable finds in the game.
items.keepReason: Best museum earner and flex item. Keep always. Only sell duplicates if you already have a perfect museum display.

items.name: Mermaid's Tear
items.description: A glowing gem said to come from a mermaid's necklace.
items.keepReason: Legendary museum value. Keep the first copy. Duplicates can be sold for a big coin boost if you need it.
